intent.proves: At least one website is active, published and not in the recycle bin.

bindings.reason: get_areas returns inactive and unpublished websites too; mcp-count has no field filter, so a projection on Active/Published is required before this binding is equivalent.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Area WHERE AreaActive = 1 AND AreaPublished = 1 AND AreaDeleted = 0
